column1: # One dataset per line, tab-separated. Paths may be absolute or relative to the run directory.
# Use "-" for an empty optional field.
# ibd:       hap-ibd .ibd(.gz) or phasedibd output (a filename containing chr1 expands to chr1..22)
# map:       PLINK map (chr rsid cM bp) matching the data's genome build; required for hap-ibd
# training:  pretrained classifier (*.classif.pkl), e.g. from `ponderosa simulate`; "-" trains from the FAM
